summary: Complete frontend testing of Pipeline page redesign at /pipeline. All 14 features tested and working correctly. The new design matches the approved mockup with Journey-style dark hero card, compact row-based school cards, filter chips, collapsible sections, and special green committed card.

pipeline_page_loads.details: Pipeline page loads at /pipeline after login, shows all school data from API

hero_card.details: Dark theme (#141422), shows University of Florida, D1 badge, 75% Match badge, social icons (X/Instagram/Facebook), progress rail with Visit stage active

hero_follow_up_button.details: Button text 'Follow Up', navigates to /journey/prog_099056ed7f86 on click

filter_chips_outreach.details: Outreach 4 filter shows only NEEDS OUTREACH section, hides other sections

filter_chips_waiting.details: Waiting 3 filter shows only WAITING ON REPLY section

filter_chips_inconvo.details: In Convo 4 filter shows only IN CONVERSATION section with UCLA, Penn State, Texas, Emory

filter_chips_committed.details: Committed 1 filter shows only COMMITTED section with Stanford

section_headers.details: Correct labels - Needs outreach (4), Waiting on reply (3), In conversation (4), Committed (1)

section_collapsible.details: Clicking header collapses section (cards went 11→7), clicking again expands (7→11)

school_card_7_columns.details: All 7 columns present - school info, progress rail, temp tag, metrics, next action, CTA, arrow

progress_rails.details: School cards show progress rails with correct stages (Added→Outreach→Talking→Visit→Offer→Committed)

temperature_tags.details: Outreach: New (teal), Waiting: Warm (orange), In Convo: Hot/Active (red/blue)

cta_buttons.details: Outreach: Start Outreach (teal), Waiting: Follow Up (amber), In Convo: Journey > (outline)

committed_card.details: Green background (#f0fdf4), check icon, 'Verbal Commit' badge, Stanford University card

view_toggle.details: Compact/Expanded toggle buttons visible and clickable

critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured at 705 lines for a complex page - good organization
Uses proper data-testid attributes for all key interactive elements
Good use of CSS variables (--t-text, --t-surface, --t-border) for theme support
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pipeline page redesign is complete and working. All features tested: hero card with dark theme, filter chips, collapsible sections, 7-column school cards, progress rails, temperature tags, CTA buttons, committed card with Verbal Commit badge. Navigation works from hero button, CTA buttons, card clicks, and Add School button. View toggle (Compact/Expanded) is visible. Demo account has 12 schools: 4 needs outreach, 3 waiting, 4 in conversation, 1 committed (Stanford).
